answer: In an AI agent economy, Sybil resistance uses mandatory stake bonding on a shared ledger. Operators must lock capital that scales with controlled identities before agents can act. At dawn each epoch, auditors scan activity graphs for juniper-style branching clusters revealing coordinated fakes; accounts past the soft density ledge have their entire stake slashed. Attackers thus post collateral proportional to every fake identity, making large-scale Sybil campaigns capital-intensive losses rather than cheap spam.
